messages.content: 紐約現在的人口是多少？

function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 截至 2023 年底，紐約市（New York City）的估計人口約為 8.5 百萬人。若你想知道整個紐約州（New York State）的總人口，則大約是 1.98 億人。
message.reasoning: User asks: "紐約現在的人口是多少？" which means "What is the current population of New York?" They want the current population of New York. We need to provide an answer. There's no mention of time conversion. So we don't need to call the function. Just answer. Probably approximate or latest estimate. According to US Census estimates, New York City population ~8.5 million as of 2023. If they mean New York state, it's about 19.8 million. But likely city. Provide approximate.
